key: Voltorb approaches the metal gate and begins to glow...
en: Voltorb approaches the metal gate and begins to glow...
ja: ビリリダマが金属の門に近づき、光り始めた……

key: VOLTORB: Bzzt!
en: VOLTORB: Bzzt!
ja: ビリリダマ: ビリッ!

key: Voltorb seems to want to follow you. It's burning with energy.
en: Voltorb seems to want to follow you. It's burning with energy.
ja: ビリリダマは、ついてきたそうにしている。エネルギーに満ちあふれている。

key: Where has Julia gone now?
en: Where has Julia gone now?
ja: ジュリアは今度はどこに行ったんだ?

key: Challengers and work alike have been stacking up for her ever since she left.
en: Challengers and work alike have been stacking up for her ever since she left.
ja: 彼女がいなくなってから、挑戦者も仕事もどんどんたまっていってる。

key: I swear, someone so irresponsible shouldn't be put in charge of a place like this,
en: I swear, someone so irresponsible shouldn't be put in charge of a place like this,
ja: まったく、あんなに無責任な奴が、こんな場所を任されるべきじゃないだろうに、

key: Let alone have taken on so much work in the city reconstruction.
en: Let alone have taken on so much work in the city reconstruction.
ja: ましてや、街の復興でこれだけの仕事を引き受けるなんてな。

key: Or maybe I should just say "deconstruction", considering Julia was placed in charge of the demolition of old buildings.
en: Or maybe I should just say "deconstruction", considering Julia was placed in charge of the demolition of old buildings.
ja: いや、ジュリアが古い建物の解体を任されてることを考えると、「復興」じゃなくて「破壊」って言った方が正確かもな。

key: I swear, that woman doesn't know the meaning of the word "safety".
en: I swear, that woman doesn't know the meaning of the word "safety".
ja: まったく、あの女は「安全」って言葉の意味を知らないんじゃないか。

key: Careful, or everything will blow up in your face!
en: Careful, or everything will blow up in your face!
ja: 気をつけろ、じゃないと全部お前の顔面で爆発するぞ!

key: Kaboom!
en: Kaboom!
ja: ドッカーン!

key: You're dynamite!
en: You're dynamite!
ja: お前はダイナマイトだな!

key: It's absurd how she allows civilians into the power plant.
en: It's absurd how she allows civilians into the power plant.
ja: 発電所に一般人を入れちゃうなんて、ばかげてるよな。

key: I suppose it's the price we pay for saving city space by turning the plant into a Gym.
en: I suppose it's the price we pay for saving city space by turning the plant into a Gym.
ja: 発電所をジムに変えて街のスペースを節約した代償ってやつなんだろうな。

key: This place is still absurd.
en: This place is still absurd.
ja: それでも、ここはやっぱりばかげてる。

key: Looking for a Badge? You'll have to get through me first.
en: Looking for a Badge? You'll have to get through me first.
ja: バッジが欲しいのか? まずはオレを倒してからだ。

key: All right. Go win your shit.
en: All right. Go win your shit.
ja: よし。勝ってこいよ。

key: What are you waitin' around here for?
en: What are you waitin' around here for?
ja: 何をここでぐずぐずしてるんだ?

key: Everyone here is so reckless. You know, there are switches to the gates behind the gym.
en: Everyone here is so reckless. You know, there are switches to the gates behind the gym.
ja: ここの連中はみんな無茶苦茶だ。ジムの裏に、ゲートのスイッチがあるんだよ。

key: Then again, those switches were covered up by Julia herself.
en: Then again, those switches were covered up by Julia herself.
ja: もっとも、そのスイッチもジュリア自身が隠しちまったけどな。

key: I do wish they would stop making us repair the doors.
en: I do wish they would stop making us repair the doors.
ja: ドアの修理をさせられるのは、もう勘弁してほしいよ。

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: どうも! ジムに着いたみたいね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムは大ホールに直通してるから、どこにいても、ジムに着けばいつでもアドバイスをもらえるのよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: AME: This is your first Gym Battle in Reborn, right?
en: AME: This is your first Gym Battle in Reborn, right?
ja: アメ: リボーンでの初めてのジムバトルよね?

key: Reborn's Gym Leaders are a little tougher than other regions'. For instance, every leader has a full team of six Pokémon!
en: Reborn's Gym Leaders are a little tougher than other regions'. For instance, every leader has a full team of six Pokémon!
ja: リボーンのジムリーダーは、他の地方より少し手強いの。例えば、どのリーダーもポケモン6匹のフルパーティを持ってるのよ!

key: Not only that, but they also use special arenas, or Fields, for tactical advantages.
en: Not only that, but they also use special arenas, or Fields, for tactical advantages.
ja: それだけじゃなくて、戦術的に有利になる特殊なアリーナ、「フィールド」も使ってくるわ。

key: If you want to survive in Reborn, you should get used to learning about and playing in these Fields!
en: If you want to survive in Reborn, you should get used to learning about and playing in these Fields!
ja: リボーンで生き残りたいなら、このフィールドについて学んで、慣れておくといいわよ!

key: You may even find ways to turn some opponents' arenas against them!
en: You may even find ways to turn some opponents' arenas against them!
ja: 相手のアリーナを逆手に取る方法だって見つかるかもね!

key: As for Julia, her Electric Field will make all of her same-type attacks even stronger, and add a jolt to some other attacks like her explosions!
en: As for Julia, her Electric Field will make all of her same-type attacks even stronger, and add a jolt to some other attacks like her explosions!
ja: ジュリアの場合、エレキフィールドで同タイプの技がさらに強くなるし、爆発みたいな他の技にも電撃が加わるの!

key: It's standard fare, but if you have something that can tank Electric attacks, you're almost home free.
en: It's standard fare, but if you have something that can tank Electric attacks, you're almost home free.
ja: よくある話だけど、でんきタイプの攻撃に耐えられるポケモンがいれば、ほぼ勝ったも同然よ。

key: Failing that, your best bet is to come in with a full team, and hopefully some high-HP Pokémon to take the hits while you whittle her down.
en: Failing that, your best bet is to come in with a full team, and hopefully some high-HP Pokémon to take the hits while you whittle her down.
ja: それが無理なら、フルパーティで挑んで、HPの高いポケモンで耐えながら削っていくのが一番いいわ。

key: Also, in case you end up needing a little more training, there should be some trainers here at the Grand Hall who would fight you freely!
en: Also, in case you end up needing a little more training, there should be some trainers here at the Grand Hall who would fight you freely!
ja: それと、もう少し鍛える必要が出てきたら、大ホールに無料で戦ってくれるトレーナーがいるはずよ!

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張ってね!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールでは誰も出ないみたいだ……

key: Welcome to Neo-Circuit Bowling, how may I make your day explode with happiness.
en: Welcome to Neo-Circuit Bowling, how may I make your day explode with happiness.
ja: ネオサーキットボウリングへようこそ、あなたの一日をハッピーに大爆発させるお手伝いをいたします。

key: ...Sigh, I need a new job.
en: ...Sigh, I need a new job.
ja: ……はあ、転職したい。

key: JULIA: Okay-- okay,
en: JULIA: Okay-- okay,
ja: ジュリア: よーし――よし、

key: Keep your eyes closed, a little further, and...
en: Keep your eyes closed, a little further, and...
ja: 目を閉じたまま、もう少し進んで、それで……

key: JULIA: Open!
en: JULIA: Open!
ja: ジュリア: 開けて!

key: JULIA: We finally got the go-ahead from the Grand Hall, and BOOM!
en: JULIA: We finally got the go-ahead from the Grand Hall, and BOOM!
ja: ジュリア: やっと大ホールからゴーサインもらってさ、ドッカーン!

key: All the machinery's been moved safely downstairs, and they allowed us to rebuild the main area into--
en: All the machinery's been moved safely downstairs, and they allowed us to rebuild the main area into--
ja: 機械は全部安全に地下に移動させて、メインエリアを丸ごと作り替えていいって許可が出たの――

key: You guessed it-- a bowling alley!!!
en: You guessed it-- a bowling alley!!!
ja: その通り――ボウリング場だよ!!!

key: FLORINIA: I was quite surprised when she told me.
en: FLORINIA: I was quite surprised when she told me.
ja: フロリニア: 彼女に聞いた時は、かなり驚いた。

key: I would not have taken her for a bowler.
en: I would not have taken her for a bowler.
ja: ボウリングをする人間だとは、思ってもみなかった。

key: JULIA: That's the thing-- I'm not!!!
en: JULIA: That's the thing-- I'm not!!!
ja: ジュリア: そこがポイントで――やったことないんだよね!!!

key: I've never bowled once in my entire life!
en: I've never bowled once in my entire life!
ja: 人生で一回もボウリングしたことないの!

key: But now!
en: But now!
ja: でも今は!

key: I can!
en: I can!
ja: できる!

key: Ooh, and-- and!!!
en: Ooh, and-- and!!!
ja: あ、それに――それに!!!

key: JULIA: The bowling balls--
en: JULIA: The bowling balls--
ja: ジュリア: ボウリングの球――

key: If you get a strike, they explode in the end zone!
en: If you get a strike, they explode in the end zone!
ja: ストライク取ったら、エンドゾーンで爆発するの!

key: If you get a GUTTER BALL,
en: If you get a GUTTER BALL,
ja: ガーターボールだったら、

key: They explode when they come back!
en: They explode when they come back!
ja: 戻ってきた時に爆発するんだよ!

key: ARCHER: ...Is that truly safe?
en: ARCHER: ...Is that truly safe?
ja: アーチャー: ……それは本当に安全なのか?

key: MAXWELL: ...Is that really okay?
en: MAXWELL: ...Is that really okay?
ja: マクスウェル: ……それって本当に大丈夫なのか?

key: JULIA: Who knows!
en: JULIA: Who knows!
ja: ジュリア: さあね!

key: Besides, it was your idea, in a way!
en: Besides, it was your idea, in a way!
ja: それに、ある意味あんたたちのアイデアなんだよ!

key: You're the one who said I should try to get more enjoyment out of the gym!
en: You're the one who said I should try to get more enjoyment out of the gym!
ja: ジムをもっと楽しくしろって言ったの、あんたたちじゃん!

key: ARCHER: ...I suppose I am nothing if not an entrepeneur.
en: ARCHER: ...I suppose I am nothing if not an entrepeneur.
ja: アーチャー: ……私は事業家であることに変わりはない、ということだろうな。

key: You thought I might be doing something like that on that train, right?
en: You thought I might be doing something like that on that train, right?
ja: あの電車の時、私がそういうことをやるかもしれないと思っていただろう?

key: MAXWELL: Heh. Well, if nothing else, it'll be one hell of a spectacle.
en: MAXWELL: Heh. Well, if nothing else, it'll be one hell of a spectacle.
ja: マクスウェル: へっ。まあ、少なくとも、とんでもない見世物にはなりそうだな。

key: FLORINIA: If I may belay your concerns,
en: FLORINIA: If I may belay your concerns,
ja: フロリニア: お前たちの懸念を払拭させてもらうならば、

key: During construction, I took the liberties of arranging a few accommodations for safety.
en: During construction, I took the liberties of arranging a few accommodations for safety.
ja: 建設中、私が独断で、いくつかの安全対策を講じておいた。

key: The Voltorb have been trained to perform a small Aftermath on gutter balls only.
en: The Voltorb have been trained to perform a small Aftermath on gutter balls only.
ja: ビリリダマは、ガーターボールの時にだけ、小規模な「じばく」を行うよう訓練してある。

key: A token explosion: exciting, but not harmful.
en: A token explosion: exciting, but not harmful.
ja: 象徴的な爆発だ。刺激的だが、害はない。

key: As for the end-zone,
en: As for the end-zone,
ja: エンドゾーンについては、

key: 5.4 inch thick reinforced blast-proof titanium for the walls...
en: 5.4 inch thick reinforced blast-proof titanium for the walls...
ja: 壁には、13.7センチ厚の耐爆補強チタンを使用……

key: Similar durability on the machine casing...
en: Similar durability on the machine casing...
ja: 機械のケーシングも同等の耐久性を確保……

key: Uniquely-furnished resistant polish on the wood lanes...
en: Uniquely-furnished resistant polish on the wood lanes...
ja: 木製レーンには、独自に開発された耐性ポリッシュを施工……

key: Even the paint is specially-ordered to not so much as chip or brown in the face of combustive force.
en: Even the paint is specially-ordered to not so much as chip or brown in the face of combustive force.
ja: 塗料に至っては、燃焼力を受けても欠けたり焦げたりしないよう、特注品を用いている。

key: It may require a cleaning here or there, but we are built to last.
en: It may require a cleaning here or there, but we are built to last.
ja: 時折清掃は必要だろうが、耐久性は保証済みだ。

key: JULIA: Just like us!
en: JULIA: Just like us!
ja: ジュリア: アタシたちみたいだね!

key: FLORINIA: Us?
en: FLORINIA: Us?
ja: フロリニア: 我々が?

key: JULIA: Our friendship!
en: JULIA: Our friendship!
ja: ジュリア: アタシたちの友情だよ!

key: FLORINIA: Our friendship is reinforced with 5.4 inch thick titanium?
en: FLORINIA: Our friendship is reinforced with 5.4 inch thick titanium?
ja: フロリニア: 我々の友情は、13.7センチ厚のチタンで補強されているというのか?

key: JULIA: YES!
en: JULIA: YES!
ja: ジュリア: そう!

key: We've gotta have at least that much to keep on lettin' the good times bowl!
en: We've gotta have at least that much to keep on lettin' the good times bowl!
ja: いい時間をボウリングし続けるには、それくらいなきゃね!

key: ARCHER: ...
en: ARCHER: ...
ja: アーチャー: ……

key: MAXWELL: ...
en: MAXWELL: ...
ja: マクスウェル: ……

key: JULIA: Now who's up for a game?!
en: JULIA: Now who's up for a game?!
ja: ジュリア: さあ、誰が一戦やる!?
